title: I ka kan
none: I ma kan sugandi n'teri. ARCHON bɛ tugu sɛrvɛri kan taalen de  kɔ, walima i ka sigininden sɛbɛn nen kɔ.

scopeServer: I ka sugandilen bɛ la baara nin sɛrivɛri in dɔrɔn de kɔnɔ. Sɛrivɛri wɛrɛw ni DMs bɛ to u sagoyaw la.
